scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @rpg-player/core-types && npm run build -w @rpg-player/pixel-studio && npm run build -w @rpg-player/rpg-engine && npm run build -w @rpg-player/narrative-editor && npm run build -w @rpg-player/vtt-network
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @rpg-player/desktop-app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @rpg-player/core-types && npm run typecheck -w @rpg-player/pixel-studio && npm run typecheck -w @rpg-player/rpg-engine && npm run typecheck -w @rpg-player/narrative-editor && npm run typecheck -w @rpg-player/vtt-network && npm run typecheck -w @rpg-player/desktop-app
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @rpg-player/desktop-app
scripts.vtt:server: npm run build -w @rpg-player/core-types && npm run build -w @rpg-player/vtt-network && npm run start -w @rpg-player/vtt-network
scripts.demo:generate: npm run build:core && tsc -p scripts/demo-pack/tsconfig.json && node scripts/demo-pack/dist/generate.js
